basic_details.job_title: Kashmir University Calligraphist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The University of Kashmir, University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar, has invited online applications from domiciles of the UT of Jammu & Kashmir for one post of Calligraphist (Persian, Postcode PGD-PN-12, UR) in the pay range of 25500–81100 / Level 4. The essential qualification is B.A. with at least 50% marks with Arabic/Persian/Urdu/Kashmiri as one of the subjects, plus a Diploma in Calligraphy from any recognized Government institution. Online forms are accepted from 12 November 2026 until 30 November 2026 (up to 4.00 p.m.) through www.kashmiruniversity.net.

age_limit.details: The age of candidates as on 01.01.2026 should be not below 18 years and not above the limit below. | Category Age Limit Open merit Not above 40 years Physically Challenged candidates Not above 42 years SC/ST-1/ST-2/BA/OBC/EWS/LAC/IB Not above 43 years Substantive in-service employees of the University Not above 50 years

how_to_apply: Visit www.kashmiruniversity.net, click the Jobs link and read the detailed instructions and the preview of the registration and submission process.
Register through the Non-Teaching Jobs link, using a valid email ID and mobile number. Remember the username and password.
Log in with the username and password.

Key in personal details, educational qualifications and experience, then preview the form. Click Edit to correct it, or Submit if the details are correct. No editing or updating is allowed after submission.
Select the online payment mode and deposit the application fee of Rs. 750 (open as well as reserved category). Persons with benchmark disabilities (PwD) are exempted.
Take a print-out of the application form and note the Form No.

Employees on regular employment in Government, Semi-Government, Public Sector or autonomous bodies of the J&K Government or Govt. of India must apply through proper channel, via their Administrative Authority. University employees apply through the Registrar of their respective Universities. They should send an advance copy to reach before the deadline. The last date for hard copies from in-service candidates applying through proper channel (if applicable) is 04.12.2026.
important_instructions: Reservation is as per S.O 305 dated 21.05.2024 issued by the UT Government, Jammu & Kashmir. Relaxation or reservation claims need a valid certificate from the competent authority. An EWS certificate must be valid at least till 31 December 2026. EWS reservation applies only where gross family annual income is below Rs. 8.00 lakh for the financial year prior to the year of application. Applications not in the prescribed form or without relevant supporting enclosures will be summarily rejected. Shortlisted applicants must submit the print-out of the online form with self-attested supporting documents when asked, and bring originals plus one set of self-attested copies. Applicants should check that their name appears in the list on the University website, and contact the Recruitment Section personally within three working days of the list being displayed. The application fee, once paid, will not be refunded or re-adjusted. The number of posts may vary, and the University reserves the right not to fill any vacancy advertised. Canvassing leads to disqualification. Impersonation or false documents lead to debarment and possible criminal prosecution. Addenda and corrigenda will be published only on the University website, and no separate communication will be sent to candidates.

content_sections.heading: About University of Kashmir
content_sections.text: The University of Kashmir is located at University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar 190006, Kashmir, and describes itself on its letterhead as NAAC Accredited Grade A++. The notice is signed by the Deputy Registrar (Recruitment) and is dated 10 November 2026. This is a university post, advertised under the University's reference No. KU/Rect/Calligraphist/Re-Advt-II/26.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only domiciles of the UT of Jammu & Kashmir may apply. Candidates must meet all eligibility conditions as on the last date fixed for submission of online application forms. Candidates with degrees from a foreign university must enclose an Equivalence Certificate issued by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU), New Delhi; without it the degree will not be considered. For discipline-specific eligibility, see the official notification. The age of candidates as on 01.01.2026 should be not below 18 years and not above the limit below.

rows.essential_qualification: B.A. with at least 50% marks with Arabic/Persian/Urdu/Kashmiri as one of the subjects; Diploma in Calligraphy from any recognized Government institution
rows.desirable: Comprehensive and skilled knowledge of computer applications

rows.category: Substantive in-service employees of the University

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries the pay range of 25500–81100 / Level 4. The appointment is provisional and subject to verification of documents and claims through proper channels, and is governed by the rules and regulations of the UT Government/University, whichever is applicable. Services of appointees are transferable between the different Satellite Campuses of the University of Kashmir.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for University of Kashmir Calligraphist
content_sections.text: Visit www.kashmiruniversity.net , click the Jobs link and read the detailed instructions and the preview of the registration and submission process. Register through the Non-Teaching Jobs link, using a valid email ID and mobile number. Remember the username and password. Log in with the username and password. Key in personal details, educational qualifications and experience, then preview the form. Click Edit to correct it, or Submit if the details are correct. No editing or updating is allowed after submission. Select the online payment mode and deposit the application fee of Rs. 750 (open as well as reserved category). Persons with benchmark disabilities (PwD) are exempted. Take a print-out of the application form and note the Form No. Employees on regular employment in Government, Semi-Government, Public Sector or autonomous bodies of the J&K Government or Govt. of India must apply through proper channel, via their Administrative Authority. University employees apply through the Registrar of their respective Universities. They should send an advance copy to reach before the deadline. The last date for hard copies from in-service candidates applying through proper channel (if applicable) is 04.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates have to undergo the process of screening/selection determined by the University. The notice mentions an OMR based Written Test, and its syllabus will be notified separately on the University website. Candidature is accepted provisionally; detailed scrutiny is done at Document Verification. If a claim is not substantiated, or the applicant is found ineligible, the candidature will be cancelled. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the OMR based Written Test.
